_scenario: Two ships on reciprocal routes (head-on). Own ship is the system under test with SBMPC COLAV, the adversary is steered by MCTS
_heading_gains: Boe (master-thesis repo, test_beds/ast_test/setup.py): own kd=66 ki=0.005, passive ship kd=75 ki=0.005. Weakly damped baseline is kd=0 ki=0
_adversary: Action seed in [0,1] maps to a heading offset in [-max, max] degrees on the adversary's LOS heading, held for action_period seconds
_reward: log(p) per action, then collision_reward or -miss_distance/miss_distance_scale at the end
_environment: Wave, wind and current are off so that an action trace always replays to the same outcome
